# TempMail Pro
> Free disposable temporary email service with multi-inbox management, custom durations (10m to 7 days), custom usernames, and sub-second OTP verification delivery.

## Overview
TempMail Pro (https://tempmailpk.com) is an anonymous, privacy-focused temporary email platform. Users can create disposable email addresses without registration, manage multiple inboxes simultaneously, choose from live premium domains (e.g., @maxxspace.com), and auto-detect OTP verification codes with 1-click copy.

## Core Features
- **Multi-Inbox Management**: Create and switch between up to 10 active disposable email accounts in parallel without paying subscription fees.
- **Custom Lifespan & Durations**: Choose email validity from 10 minutes, 1 hour, 24 hours, up to 7 days, or specify custom durations.
- **Custom Username Creation**: Set personalized email aliases or generate randomized secure usernames.
- **Live OTP Auto-Detection**: Verification codes and PINs sent by services (Discord, Craigslist, gaming sites, free trial platforms) are automatically extracted with a 1-click copy badge.
- **Zero-Log Privacy Policy**: No IP address logging, no browser fingerprinting, and no tracking cookies. All emails are wiped permanently upon mailbox expiry.
- **Progressive Web App (PWA)**: Works offline with local message caching and can be installed natively on Android, iOS, Windows, and macOS.
